authority: Algebraic type-checking control; finite lattice quotients and relation lattices remain separate candidates.

typed_path.weakest_open_obligation: replace the destination by an explicitly typed finite quotient or other torsion-bearing object

dimension.scope: An ordinary lattice is not an abelian variety.

group_order.scope: Z^m has no nonzero finite-order element, hence no order-r image.

field_of_definition.scope: The proposal is already ill-typed as a torsion transfer.

existence.scope: The ordinary lattice exists, but it lacks the needed torsion.

explicit_construction.scope: No torsion-bearing quotient or reconstruction map is supplied.

map_correctness.scope: The only group homomorphism from Z/rZ to Z^m is zero.

subgroup_preservation.scope: A zero map is not injective on S.

scalar_recovery.scope: The image contains no scalar information.

destination_solver_applicability.scope: There is no valid transported subgroup.

open_obligations: Name a finite quotient Lambda/L, torus, kernel lattice, or relation lattice and prove non-circular coordinate recovery.
